title: Insider adviser's email pointing to Greek mythology and Prometheus
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Insider adviser's email pointing to Greek mythology and Prometheus, about 2015 at unspecified (email), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: at one point somebody sent us this long email. One of his most trusted adviserss said, "Have you thought about have you really looked how much do you know >> about Greek mythology?"

plain: Peter Levenda, a researcher and writer, says that around 2015, while working with the musician Tom DeLonge, they got a long email from one of DeLonge's most trusted advisers asking how much they really knew about Greek mythology. The hint, as the story is framed, pointed toward Prometheus, the Greek figure who stole fire from the gods for humans. If true, insiders would be suggesting that ancient myths hold clues about contact with non-human beings.
